item.title: Six killed as double-decker bus hit van on Yamuna Expressway in UP's Hathras
item.description: Three women among dead, six injured including children; van carrying Delhi families was headed to Rajasthan when accident occurred at 4.20 am

item.title: Asian markets slide, oil prices surge on escalating Iran war fears
item.description: Nikkei drops over 2%, South Korean shares tumble as crude climbs on Strait of Hormuz supply risks; airlines and energy stocks under pressure

item.title: Toxic gas leak from chemical unit triggers evacuation of over 2,600 people in Palghar
item.description: The oleum gas leak affected areas in a five-km radius of the unit in the Boisar MIDC locality on Mumbai's outskirts and led to the evacuation as a precautionary measure, said officials

item.title: Nitish Kumar's son Nishant to join politics, formal announcement soon: JD(U) leader
item.description: Bihar minister Sharwan Kumar says decision finalised; Nishant likely to be given bigger role in party, Rajya Sabha option not ruled out

item.title: Allow 5 court-named persons for symbolic prayers at Tirupparankundram: HC to govt
item.description: Court proposes 15-minute prayer by five persons, pulls up TN minister for ‘mischievous political spin’; hearing adjourned to March 4

item.title: Tirunelveli: Armed gang runs amok in indiscriminate attack near Nanguneri; 2 killed
item.description: Masked assailants attack residents of Perumpathu village with sickles; villagers stage road blockade demanding swift arrests

item.title: Srinagar police file FIR against media outlets over ‘fake news’ on Khamenei protests
item.description: Case registered at Cyber Police Station for alleged circulation of fabricated content to incite unrest amid massive protests in Kashmir Valley

item.title: Iran-Israel conflict: CBSE postpones class 10, 12 board exams in Middle East
item.description: Exams deferred in Bahrain, Iran, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and UAE; fresh dates to be announced after review of regional security situation

item.title: Limited UAE-India flights resume amid conflict, bringing relief to stranded passengers
item.description: Limited operations restart from Dubai and Abu Dhabi to Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru; airlines run special flights as Gulf airspace reopens gradually amid ongoing tensions

item.title: How Gen Z is recolouring the Holi canvas, pushing for mindful celebrations
item.description: Gone are the days of licensing inappropriate behaviour with the excuse of 'bura na mano Holi hai'. For a generation that spends extensive periods of time in the virtual world, this high-physical-contact festival comes with the caveat of consent, respecting boundaries and ensuring sustainability.
